scope: Isolated source-scale experiments only. These ran alongside the complete production suite and cannot accept throughput/RSS gates. None of the prototype files changed main runtime, tests or workflow. Full real-source output checks use the frozen pair corpus.

reparse.scope: Exploratory isolated Rust adapter output/lifetime comparison. Entire ordered payloads agree; runs overlap the current production full suite and do not qualify timing/RSS gates. Not integrated into product runtime.

syntaxOracle.scope: Exploratory 120 seeded two-file syntax/receiver/import/trait/macro/recovery equivalence cases. Does not qualify native Rust semantics, scalability or full incremental correctness.

canonicalOracle.scope: Exploratory persisted canonical byte/hash equality, not a new identity format

aggregationOracle.scope: Exploratory bounded 500-node scalar counter aggregation; complete projection equality and original prefix underflow/error/rollback semantics

limitations: No generated client or handler matching without explicit API namespace

decisions.reparse: Reject as a memory optimization. Ordered output agrees but exploratory native Rust peak grew from 654720 to 1025568 KiB; extra parse/native wrapper work is not justified.
decisions.cursor: Promising CPU mechanism; four complete ordered Rust corpus outputs and 120 seeded syntax/recovery/import/receiver cases agree. It is not a qualified production provider change.
decisions.canonical: 1500 seeded canonical hash cases, unsupported values and sparse arrays agree. A production implementation still needs registered tests and complete qualification.
decisions.export: Four exact pretty-JSON byte cases and failed-serialization old-file preservation agree. Prototype atomic export permission/symlink/stale-temp handling is not qualified.
decisions.counter: 500-node batches retain each counter minimum prefix, not only final deltas; original underflow/error/transaction rollback witnesses agree. A naive negative architecture-counter UPSERT was rejected by SQLite CHECK and corrected to update-first before the recorded passing witness.
decisions.lifecycleAndCache: The combined candidate disposes compiler language services and uses 16 MiB writer cache. Their individual memory/performance effects are not isolated; do not adopt either on these figures alone.
decisions.gate: Even the combined experiments remain over 60s and 1GiB, and overlap other tests. No gate is revised or marked passed.
